safety.title: Not for urgent care
safety.body: This app is not monitored for urgent care. If you experience severe weakness, breathing problems, swallowing problems, serious falls, or other urgent symptoms, contact your clinic or emergency services.

home.checkinsThisCycle: {count, plural, =0 {No check-ins yet this cycle} one {# check-in this cycle} other {# check-ins this cycle}}
home.noActiveGoalsBody: Your suggestions are with your care team. You'll talk about them together at your next visit.
home.noSuggestionsBody: When you're ready, you can suggest something you'd like treatment to help with.
home.suggestedGoalsCount: {count, plural, one {# goal suggested} other {# goals suggested}}

suggestGoal.cancelConfirmBody: Your draft will be kept. You can come back and finish it later.
suggestGoal.draftResumed: Picking up where you left off.

step1.title: What area would you like help with?
step1.helper: Pick what fits best. You can add more detail in the next steps.

step2.title: In your own words
step2.helper: Describe what you'd like to be able to do, or do more easily. There are no right or wrong words.
step2.example1: I'd like to be able to open my left hand for washing.
step2.example2: I want fewer leg spasms at night so I can sleep.
step2.example3: I'd like to walk to the corner shop without my knee giving way.

step3.title: How important is this to you?
step3.helper: Your honest answer helps your team set priorities.

step4.title: Anything your team should know?
step4.helper: Optional. For example, when it's harder, what helps, what you've tried.
step4.placeholder: Add anything that feels useful (or skip this step)…

summary.title: Ready to send?
summary.body: Your team will see this before your next visit. You can change or remove it any time before then.

thanks.title: Thank you
thanks.body: Your suggestion is now with your care team. You'll talk about it at your next visit.

checkin.cancelConfirmBody: Your answers so far will be kept. You can come back and finish at any time this week.
checkin.rateGoalTitle: How did this week go for this goal?
checkin.rateGoalHelper: The middle option is what your care team realistically expects this week. Pick the one that best describes how the week went.
checkin.scaleTapPrompt: Tap a point above to see what it means for this goal.
checkin.commentHelper: Optional. A line or two if anything stood out.
checkin.commentSafetyNote: For urgent concerns, contact your clinic.
checkin.summaryBody: Your care team will see this. You can submit it now.
checkin.thanksBody: Your check-in is recorded. See you next week.

goal.howMeasuredHelper: Your care team uses a five-step scale. The middle step is what your team realistically expects.

status.discussAtNextVisit: Will be discussed at your next visit
